page_title: WER 4-1 BOC | Werder Bremen v Bochum 18/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Bochum fail to score from a corner as Michael Zetterer (Werder Bremen) leaps to collect the ball.
90+4' Werder Bremen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum.
90' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Romano Schmid is replaced by Isak Hansen-Aaroen (Werder Bremen).

87' 4 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 4:1. Manuel Riemann was helpless.
85' Felix Agu goes off the pitch and Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) comes on.

85' 3 - 1 Goal! A terrific long pass from Kevin Stoger picks out an unmarked Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the top left corner. 3:1.
80' 3 - 0 What a sweet header! Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) leaps high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box and scores with a trademark header.
78' 2 - 0 Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) scores from a seemingly difficult position as he leaps high to head home a cross, putting the ball beyond the reach of the goalkeeper.
77' Substitution. Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) on for Maximilian Wittek.
77' The substitution has been made. Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) has replaced Tim Oermann.
77' Heiko Butscher has decided to substitute Anthony Losilla and he is replaced by Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum).
73' That's the end of the game for Leonardo Bittencourt, who is replaced by Christian Gross (Werder Bremen).
73' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) replacing Nick Woltemade.
68' The corner is swung in but Bochum can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
67' Bochum failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
67' We are about to witness a subsitution. Takuma Asano (Bochum) for Moritz Broschinski.
64' Tim Oermann (Bochum) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Werder Bremen comes to nothing.
59' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Werder Bremen win a corner kick.
57' Werder Bremen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
54' The referee points to the corner flag and Bochum will take a corner.
52' The game is interrupted now, Manuel Riemann (Bochum) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
48' Bernardo (Bochum) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
47' The referee signals a corner kick to Bochum.
46' Half-time substitution. Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is replaced by Jens Stage.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Heiko Butscher gives a chance to Matus Bero and Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' A superb shot by Kevin Stoger (Bochum) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar.
44' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Bochum earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
39' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum.
38' The resulting set piece from Werder Bremen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
37' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) sees a yellow card from Martin Petersen after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
36' Today's referee Martin Petersen rightly decides to book Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) for his harsh tackle.
36' Werder Bremen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
36' Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Werder Bremen force a corner. They send men into the box.
34' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.
33' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) whips a volley from long range towards the goal. His beautiful effort whistles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.

31' What a big chance! Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
28' Bochum can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

28' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Michael Zetterer leaps like a salmon to deny him. Now Bochum have a corner.
27' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
23' Werder Bremen are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
20' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) was too forceful with his tackle and Martin Petersen interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

19' What a chance that is! Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
18' The corner from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is cleared away by the defence.

14' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
11' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Michael Zetterer is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
10' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
6' Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

6' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Manuel Riemann sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner. Werder Bremen get a corner.
3' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Bochum will take the kick-off.
Martin Petersen is introduced as the referee for today's match.
